name: Peaches & Cream - Infused Ice Packs (Rosin, Hash, and Diamonds) 5x 0.5g
description: Rove Ice Packs, the world’s first triple-infused preroll. Made with premium-grade flower fully-infused with THCA diamonds and solventless ice hash rosin then they're expertly rolled. Super smooth and ultra potent, Rove Ice Packs test up to 40% THC. Welcome to the next evolution of prerolls. Premium Organic Flower. Peaches and Cream is here to give you the best of both worlds - an energizing boost for creative ideas and a calming effect for winding down. Get ready to be peachy keen!
